limitations.note: The rewrite eliminated the repeated green reload but also made red assert immediately on reset, removing the all-lights-off startup interval that the one-line fix preserves and shifting the subsequent countdown and light timing.
The test required red to be active during reset and assumed the rewrite’s startup timing, so passing it did not verify that the fix preserved the original cycle-by-cycle behavior.
The rewrite removed the original public state parameters, so an existing instantiation that overrides one of them would no longer elaborate.
